title: Credible sandbox-based federated learning model training method and device and electronic equipment
assignee: Yunnan Provincial Academy Of Science And Technology

pse.problem: Privacy-preserving data sharing and protection of trust issues during transmission and computation in traditional federated learning
pse.solution_function: A method performs federated learning model training within a trusted sandbox created by the MEC server based on blockchain state channel. It involves registering device information, selecting target local devices for federated learning, distributing global model and training request, collecting local models, aggregating them to obtain a new global model, and applying incentive mechanism.
pse.solution_structure: The structure includes MEC server, blockchain platform, multiple local devices communicatively connected to the MEC server, and trusted sandbox created by MEC server based on blockchain state channel.
pse.solution_implementation: The method involves sending device information for registration, determining target local devices for federated learning, receiving global model and training request from blockchain platform, distributing them to multiple target local devices, collecting local models, aggregating them to obtain new global model, sending first device information and second device information to blockchain platform for consensus, obtaining incentive mechanism of blockchain platform, applying it to the target local device.
pse.effect: Privacy-preserving federated learning model training with trust issues protected during transmission and computation on a blockchain platform
